notes.title: Update the game
notes.notes:
3.1.2

- rename score -> hitpoint, reference point -> score because of changing the concept.
- New graphics profile that adds specular to the plate. It affects the reflection of fruit color.
- Change plate to guard niddling.
- Adjustment physics to guard niddling.
- BGM ON becomes the default.
- instead of a new graphics profile, the grass sphere is invisible.
- the physics friction value adjustment of fruits surface.
- Plate selection available in Fever DLC.

- bugfix: steam rank display
- bugfix: some Korean and Japanese fonts missing

notes.notes: Physics Behavior has been modified to reduce the strange results.

Best Score change to Best Reference Score.

Coming 3.0,  "Score" is changed to "HitPoint", Refenece score is changed to "SCORE".
To clarify the two points, the rename would be applied.

notes.title: MorePlates DLC is out
notes.notes:
MorePlates DLC has been released.
- Small Fruits game/More Fruits game
The types of fruits that are launchable out are different.
Fruit platter: 5 types
More options: 10 types
- Regular mode/Overflow mode
The penalty when fruit falls off the plate is different.
Regular mode: If it falls, your score will be zero.
Overflow mode: If the fruit falls, a different penalty will be subtracted from your score.
- Addition of plate types

notes.title: SUIKA DISH Fever DLC available
notes.notes:
SUIKA DISH Fever DLC available.
It's free.
Combos invoke Fever to add extra fruits on the plate.
The fever adds to the Overflow mode.


Gain fever points aiming combos.

If you want to play the game without fever mode, by using DLC management, remove this DLC
to play without fever mode.

notes.notes:
Thank you for particitating the PlayTest.
We've got many good feedbacks. In order to improve the game, they would help us.

notes.title: Game bug fix and various changes.
notes.notes:
Updated.

-Fruits order is changed. (Cherry and Plum, Avocado and Orange, Pear and Grape)

-A little physics adjustment. Moderated.

-Localization bugfix

-Penalty points are changed.  -(points x 10)

-Hints are added.

-Sound effects are changed.

- UI revised.

    -   Add vertical cursor and drop indeicator.

- Reference score is added.

- Various Configuration is added.

- Overflow mode is default.

    - Overflow mode becomes default. In this mode, the fruits falling off the plate does not mean game over.

       When the score is positive, some points are substracted from the score. The game still goes on. 

       When the score is 0 or less, if fruits fall off the plate, the game is over.   


- Niddled fruits go back to plate

- Configurable camera position and direction and fov

- Multilingual support (many)

-Change behaviour when merging .

-Niddled fruits never merged bug fix.

notes.title: PlayTest continued.
notes.notes:
The PlayTest period will be extended by several days.
Because the fever becomes moderate than current playtest version. And fruits order is changed to stabilize the behavior in merging.

notes.title: PlayTest for More Plates DLC
notes.notes:
Join PlayTest for More Plates DLC.
We are waiting for STEAM team to review the app for PlayTest.
Shortly it would be permitted. Stay tuned.




More Plates DLC has many options. So it is difficult to make its game balance be suitable.
It has two game types; Regular game and More Fruits game and 
it has two game modes; Onplate mode and Overviewmode;

Regular game and Onplate mode; it is very hard. Stuk at it. You would be confused.
Regular game and Overflow mode; it is basic. it has a fever.
More Fruits game and Onplate mode; it would be interesting to pursue the score;
More Fruits game and Overflow mode; it has fever. so the score will be inflated than expected.

Although it has the same name as "SUIKA DISH", 
the game is different depending on the combination of game type and game mode.
They have different characteristics.

The 4 combinations and 8 plates size, so there are 32 patterns. You will find
the game which is interesting for you. 

Please leave a review once your watermelon is completed! !
